org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.business

Class AcsMgmt

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.business.AcsMgmt

  • public class AcsMgmt
extends Object
    EJB Session bean for the ACS command interface. This EJB is the single entry point to the ACS interface called from executors and diagnostic user interfaces. All calls are delegated to the ExtInfFactory which will delegate to either the actual RPC client interface or a simulator.
    Author:
    smichaels
